scope: Separate warmed paced deadline pass and unpaced phase diagnostics. Deadlines include input generation, inference, host output extraction and device completion; absolute monotonic releases, no dropped steps. Combined from two separate measurement batches; see measurement_batches for provenance.
statistics: Equal-weight mean and sample SD (ddof=1) across seeds; no division by sqrt(n). Per-window samples are not independent seed replicates.

advance_breakdown.scope: Separate warmed unpaced pass with phase-boundary wall/thread-CPU clocks and device completion fences; no PyTorch profiler or cProfile active.
advance_breakdown.limits: Phases are nonoverlapping. Full advance is inclusive. Other includes timer bookkeeping and API entry/exit. Compiled block includes dispatch, input views, invocation and completion wait, not just numerical kernels. Thread CPU excludes workers/device compute. Instrumentation changes timing.

validation.probe: seeded Poisson input with synchronous burst at every window start
